name: measurement-profile
goal: Entity size measurements appear within Performance profile without a separate Size card.

evidence: Size and Performance profile currently render separate cards. Group the same measurements in Performance profile across overview and legacy details; preserve values, notes, profiles and responsive layout.

Standardized entity overview/details tests require separate Size and Performance regions. Strengthen those tests and visual-overview browser checkpoints to require one Performance profile containing all size rows at current and selected commits across three widths.
